rule: No owner, status, next_role, output_path and proof means not done.

tasks.title: Keep task board current
tasks.next_action: Review all new work and add/close tasks with proof paths.
tasks.done_proof: Every active work item has owner/status/next_action/output_path.

tasks.title: Maintain agent memory ledger
tasks.next_action: Add important decisions, failed ideas, lessons and competitor findings after each work cycle.
tasks.done_proof: Memory files contain dated entries and prevent repeated weak work.

tasks.title: Build competitor intelligence database
tasks.next_action: Add first 20 competitors with offer, price, CTA, weakness and exploitable gap.
tasks.done_proof: At least 20 competitor profiles and 3 weekly gap actions.

tasks.title: Enforce product maturity gates
tasks.next_action: Assign stage to each product and block sell/deploy without checklist proof.
tasks.done_proof: Every product has stage, blocker list and next gate.

tasks.title: Close deploy loop
tasks.next_action: Add deploy command, health check, smoke test and rollback note for each deployed product.
tasks.done_proof: Product can be deployed, checked and rolled back from documented steps.

tasks.title: Run QA critic layer
tasks.next_action: Break-test demo, record bugs and block release if critical failure exists.
tasks.done_proof: Bug board and critic checklist are updated before release.

tasks.title: Operate revenue pipeline
tasks.next_action: Add target leads, contact state, reply state, demo state and invoice state.
tasks.done_proof: Pipeline shows movement from target to paid pilot.

tasks.title: Track CFO economics
tasks.next_action: Track cost, build time, package price, margin and break-even target.
tasks.done_proof: Every offer has price, cost, gross margin and break-even logic.

tasks.title: Standardize 72h delivery
tasks.next_action: Use intake form and 72h delivery playbook before taking paid pilots.
tasks.done_proof: Pilot has intake, scope, delivery steps, QA and handoff.

tasks.title: Map internal OS to marketplace roadmap
tasks.next_action: Convert internal inventory/location/pricing logic into seller, buyer, listing, order and search modules.
tasks.done_proof: Roadmap has modules, dependencies, data entities and first MVP slice.
